manual_checks: Heading sequence contains one H1 followed by H2/H3 hierarchy without skips.
Skip link is present and visible on keyboard focus.
All meaningful images have alternative text; the SVG icon sprite is hidden from assistive technology.
External new-tab links use rel=noopener noreferrer.
Mobile navigation exposes expanded state, moves focus to the first link, closes with Escape, and unlocks after closure.
Reduced-motion mode leaves content visible, keeps the original specialist headline static, and disables decorative headline/role/reveal motion.
Light and dark settled states were visually inspected at desktop and mobile sizes.
claim_boundary: An automated scan with zero detected violations is not a certification of complete WCAG conformance. Gradient/composited contrast and real assistive-technology behavior still require human review.
